# Advon Media

> Greek web agency (Athens) that builds professional websites for Greek small businesses and professionals — doctors, dentists, psychologists, physiotherapists, lawyers, accountants, hospitality — with no deposit: the client sees the finished draft first and pays only the hosting (€10.83/month, billed €130/year) if they like it. 200+ live websites, 5.0 rating with 110+ Google reviews.

## Services
- [Website build without deposit](https://advonmedia.com/kataskevi-istoselidas): free build, pay hosting only after the first draft; bilingual EL/EN, fast, SEO-ready.
- [Google presence & reviews (NFC review kit)](https://advonmedia.com/google-reviews-nfc)
- [Online appointments](https://advonmedia.com/online-rantevou)
- [AI website assistant](https://advonmedia.com/ai-voithos)
- [Direct booking for hotels, apartments & villas](https://advonmedia.com/direct-booking)
- [QR digital menu](https://advonmedia.com/psifiako-menou-qr)
- [Custom mini-software](https://advonmedia.com/custom-logismiko)
- [Social media management](https://advonmedia.com/diaxeirisi-social-media)
